message: Set ECOCHINA2_BIVARIATE_ZONES and ECOCHINA2_BIVARIATE_SCENARIOS to draw zone-level climate x soil maps.
Set ECOCHINA2_BIVARIATE_SCENARIOS to draw bivariate species maps.
Set ECOCHINA2_BIVARIATE_SCENARIOS to draw bivariate population maps.
Set ECOCHINA2_STACK_SCENARIOS to draw Top-5 candidate details.
Set ECOCHINA2_STACK_SCENARIOS to draw Top-5 candidate maps.
